segments.title: 第124章 MV導演應禪溪
segments.content:
Reigniting the Prime of Youth Chapter 124: MV Director Ying Chanxi

"Speaking of which."

After returning to apartment 1502 in Bihai Lanting, Ying Chanxi thought of the rock club Li Luo was in, then thought about how the club's next performance would be during the sports festival, and from there thought that she could take some photos at the sports festival.

Finally, she took a camera out of her bedroom and said to Li Luo, "Didn't you write a song last time and ask Zhu Sheng to record it for you?"

"Yeah, what's wrong?" Hearing Ying Chanxi bring this up, Li Luo felt somewhat conflicted.

After all, Xu Youyu also knew about this song, and at the same time, she was watching his novel.

If he wrote the song "Waiting For You" into his novel, there was a high chance Xu Youyu would see it.

Wouldn't he be confessing without being prompted, directly exposing his alternate identity?

But it wasn't good to just hold onto it, and who knew when Jay Chou would write this song.

Li Luo was a bit surprised that Ying Chanxi was mentioning this now.

"It's nothing, I was just thinking," Ying Chanxi asked curiously, "since you've already recorded it, why haven't you released it?"

"Um... I guess I was busy and forgot."

It actually wasn't hard to write this song into the book.

After all, it counted as his "original song," and in books about literary plagiarism, creating original works was a major taboo.

Therefore, if Li Luo wanted to insert this kind of original song into his book, he certainly wouldn't arrange it as part of the main plot.

At most, it would be a small, occasional side story that would reasonably incorporate the song, to the extent that even if this side story were removed, the main plot wouldn't be affected.

This way, the instability of an original song could be controlled within an acceptable range.

After all, for the same song, "Waiting For You," when it was released by Jay Chou, plenty of people said he was past his prime. Li Luo couldn't guarantee how good the results would be if he released the song himself.

It was better to maintain a cautiously optimistic attitude.

But Ying Chanxi obviously didn't think that far. She just raised the camera in her hand and smilingly suggested to Li Luo, "Usually when singers release a song, they'll record an MV for it. So if you want to release your song, how about we record one too?"

"An MV?" Li Luo blinked, not quite registering it. "We shoot it ourselves?"

"That's right." Ying Chanxi nodded. "Isn't your song 'Waiting For You' about a college romance? Qianjiang University is right next door to us, so finding a location is no problem at all."

"Then who's going to be in it?" Li Luo took two small puddings out of the fridge and handed one to Ying Chanxi. "Are you going to be the MV director?"

"I'm the director and the female lead." Ying Chanxi puffed out her chest, then pointed at Li Luo. "And you're the male lead."

"Just the two of us?"

"Just the two of us."

"Give me the specifics?"

"It's simple." Ying Chanxi put the camera aside, took the small pudding, tore open the wrapper and popped it in her mouth, then patted Li Luo's shoulder. "What's your song about?"

"Waiting for you after class, of course."

"There you go." Ying Chanxi smiled. "We can just shoot it bit by bit, following the imagery in the lyrics."

"The opening lyrics say, 'I rented an apartment.'" Ying Chanxi pointed at the floor, indicating that they had one ready-made. "Later it says, 'Why didn't I study hard for three years in high school.'"

As she spoke, she pointed in the direction of Fuzhong No. 1 High School.

"Then there's making egg crepes, which you can do in the kitchen."

"Lying on your school's athletic field, gazing at the starry sky... isn't a field easy to find?" Ying Chanxi even hummed a short tune, then winked at Li Luo. "So, pretty simple, right?"

"It's not impossible." Li Luo looked at the interested gleam in Ying Chanxi's eyes and suddenly recalled what she had said when the two of them were strolling around Qianjiang University before.

—"If I really had financial freedom, I think I'd probably become a photographer."

Looking at it now, there was no harm in realizing this dream a little early.

"But we don't usually have much time, and you still have to prepare for the math competition."

"It's okay, we can take our time." Ying Chanxi shook her head. "We're not aiming to finish filming in a few days. We can take longer. Whenever we think of it and find suitable inspiration, we can just shoot a small part."

"I'll follow Director Ying's arrangements."

After talking it over, the two finished their small puddings, and Ying Chanxi eagerly pulled Li Luo to start filming right there in the apartment.

After tinkering for an entire afternoon, they successfully finished filming "rented an apartment" and "learned to make egg crepes."

But perhaps because it was her first time trying this kind of filming, after Ying Chanxi uploaded the videos to her computer, she felt that nothing was shot well, so she clamored for a reshoot next time.

Li Luo had no objections and just let her do as she pleased.

In the evening, after dinner, Ying Chanxi obediently went to study, and Li Luo returned to his bedroom to seriously write and build up a stockpile of chapters.

Around eight in the evening, Xu Youyu came back from home.

Hurrying into her bedroom, she also began her writing for the day.

After finishing a chapter around ten, the QQ icon at the bottom of her computer screen suddenly started flashing.

Xu Youyu took a look and saw it was her editor, Qian Zhou.

Qian Zhou: Your current book has reached an average subscription of 2000. I remember you're from Qianjiang Province, right?

Sleeping Early Makes You Taller: That's right.

Qian Zhou: Here's the thing, Qianjiang Province established the country's first provincial-level online writers' association this year.

Qian Zhou: Your results aren't bad now, so I was thinking of recommending you.

Reading her editor's words, Xu Youyu instantly raised her eyebrows.

To be honest, she really hadn't paid attention to this kind of news.

Online authors already have an official organization?

Thinking of this, Xu Youyu felt a little expectant and quickly replied.

Sleeping Early Makes You Taller: Okay, I have no problem with that.

Qian Zhou: Alright, then it's settled. I'll submit your name, and I'll notify you when the results are out.

Sleeping Early Makes You Taller: Okay.

Qian Zhou: Oh, right, it seems the Online Writers' Association is holding a symposium in February. We have a few invitation slots on our end.

Qian Zhou: If you get admitted into the association by then, I can recommend you to go check it out. Your winter break should have started by February, right?

Sleeping Early Makes You Taller: That's right. Can I go too?

Qian Zhou: Of course. Since the association has relatively few members right now, basically any member of the Online Writers' Association can go.

Sleeping Early Makes You Taller: Okay, as long as I don't have anything else going on then, I should be able to go.

Qian Zhou: Mm, that's all for now then.

After chatting with her editor, Xu Youyu was full of anticipation, and her motivation to write became much stronger.

And on the other side, Li Luo also received a message from his editor.

Qian Zhou: There's a symposium in February, are you interested?

(End of this chapter)
